native_result.query: How does the prevalence of non-native plants introduced via gardening vary based on habitat type?
native_result.HypoA: The prevalence of gardening-introduced non-native plants differs between urban/cropland habitats and natural habitats.
native_result.HypoB: Prevalence of Gardening-introduced non-native plants varies strongly and significantly with habitat type: concentrated (relative share 0.54-0.56, high presence rate and absolute occurrence intensity) in Wetlands, Coastal, Riparian and Urban habitats; significantly lower in Croplands (share ~0.185, OR vs Urban = 0.54, p=0.005); essentially absent from Rock outcrops; forest/scrubland categories had too few non-native records to be quantitatively ranked.
native_result.WorkflowB: 1) Aggregated n.gard/n.unint/n.agfo/n.total per habitat (632 plots, 10 habitats). 2) Computed three prevalence metrics: share n.gard/n.total (Wilson 95% CI), mean occurrence/plot, plot-presence rate. 3) MC chi-square homogeneity on 10 and 6 (well-sampled) habitats: chi2=31.4, p<0.0001. 4) Plot-level quasi-binomial GLM (scale=X2) with F-test for habitat effect (F(5,173)=4.20, p=0.0013) and Wald OR contrasts vs Urban. 5) Supporting: rank comparisons (Kruskal-Wallis/Mann-Whitney) of habitat.range and number.of.invaded.plots across pathways in invasion_success_pathways.csv (n=81). 6) Context: Gardening share by period from temporal_trends_contingency_table.csv. Phylogenetic tree and landscape/climate covariates not used (out of scope).

sub_hypo.context: 632 plots across 10 habitat types in Barcelona province; analyses also considered six well-sampled habitats.

sub_hypo.context: Wetlands, Coastal, Riparian and Urban habitats within the sampled plots in Barcelona province.

sub_hypo.text: Gardening-introduced non-native plants have significantly lower prevalence in Croplands than in Urban habitats.
sub_hypo.context: Cropland and Urban habitats within the sampled plots in Barcelona province; Urban is the reference for the odds contrast.
sub_hypo.relations: Croplands have a Gardening share of approximately 0.185 and lower odds than Urban habitats: OR=0.54, p=0.005.

sub_hypo.relations: Gardening prevalence is approximately zero in Rock outcrops.
